```yaml
descriptor:
  id: noncompliant-device-report
  name: Noncompliant device report
  description: Reviews managed devices and reports noncompliant ones for admin
    action.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_managed_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Reads managed devices from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - complianceState
        - userPrincipalName
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliancestate
    format: transform
    label: Count by complianceState
    detail: Breaks managed devices down by complianceState.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_managed_devices.output }}'
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - noncompliant
        - compliant
        - unknown
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short managed devices report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review managed devices for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual,
        and conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total managed devices: {{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}. Details: {{
        count_by_compliancestate.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding,
        what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Reviewing {{ load_managed_devices.output | size }} managed devices." }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_compliancestate.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output }}'
```
